description: Read from the Quriobot API: a GET, or a POST to a list ("…/list"). Changes nothing. Pass query {"fields": "count,items(id,subject)"} to get only those fields (Google partial-response syntax).

organisation.description: The organisation's id, sent as the Organisation header

path.description: Under /0.0.1/backoffice/ ("live_chats/list"), or a full path starting with /0.0.1/. No query string: use "query"

query.description: Query string parameters, e.g. {"fields": "count,items(id,number,subject)"} for only those fields

name: read
